title: Tracing tactical standup notes 2027-08-02
content:
Context: quick tactical standup focused on trace sampling adjustments, dashboard tidy, and an anomalous billing spike in cost-telemetry ingestion. Notes are rough; action owners assigned and follow-up sync planned Friday.

Attendees:
- Ravi Kapoor (owner)
- Maya Liu
- Jonah Park
- Priya Nair
- Ethan Brooks
- Guests: Sasha (SRE rotation) for 15m

Quick status headlines:
- Sampling experiment alpha: baseline traces retained ~12% of requests, goal is 5% for stable services. We observed high variance for low-qps tails.
- Dashboards: five panels in "topology-latency" found to be pulling 30% of the dashboard query time; candidate for pre-aggregation.
- Cost telemetry: ingestion spike on 2027-07-30 (billing window) correlates to a misconfigured agent in eu-west that sent full-span payloads instead of summary.

Observations / details:
1) Sampling experiment (OBS-412):
   - Jonah ran the 2nd-week sample run on canary and saw CPU on collector nodes +18% during preseeding phase. Hypothesis: false positives from the regex-based service name mapper causing extra metadata tags and larger span sizes.
   - Maya reproduced the false-positive locally; changing the mapper to a smaller suffix-rule reduces span cardinality by ~42%.
   - Decision: roll the mapper fix to canary tonight (after 6pm PST) and observe 24h. If stable, include in production rollout window Tue 09:00 UTC.

2) Dashboards + query cost pruning:
   - Ethan identified 5 panels hitting expensive joins across traces and metrics. Two quick wins: convert join to pre-joined materialized view, reduce time-range to 7d for default, and add a throttled refresh on heavy panels.
   - Action: Ethan to open a PR for materialized view definitions (github PR link in linked_artifacts).
   - UX note: default dashboard time window change requires a short product announcement; Priya to draft a one-paragraph in-console blurb.

3) Cost-telemetry ingestion spike root cause:
   - On 2027-07-30 03:14 UTC, eu-west agent version v1.8.4 started sending full span payloads due to a rolling config rollback (ops pipeline accidentally applied a legacy config).
   - Estimated extra bytes: ~1.2 TB over 12 hours; cost impact ~+$6.5k for that billing cycle. Billing alerted by automated rule; ticket created: OBS-COST-2027-07-30.
   - Short-term mitigation: block the v1.8.4 agent image in eu-west, and add a pre-apply config lint in the ops pipeline.
   - Action: Priya + Sasha to add lint rule and ops policy by EOD Thursday.

4) Runbook gaps identified:
   - Runbook section "cost spike triage" is incomplete for region-specific agent rollbacks. Need concrete play steps and who-to-call list.
   - Action: Ravi to draft runbook fragment and assign to on-call rotation for review. Goal: published by Mon 2027-08-09.

Open questions / risks:
- Does the suffix-rule mapper change impact any downstream analytics jobs that rely on long service names? Jonah to run a query to list dependent jobs and file a dependency matrix by Friday.
- Pre-aggregation of the topology panels will increase storage; need quick cost estimate before approving. Ethan to run short simulation with 30-day retention estimate and present numbers in next sync.
- Agent linting will catch config shape issues but not semantic regressions (e.g., legacy keys). Consider adding a canary gating step in deploy flow.

Action items (owner, due):
- Jonah: roll mapper fix to canary tonight (2027-08-02 18:30 PST) and monitor (due 2027-08-03). Linked ticket OBS-412.
- Maya: run local regression tests for mapper change and produce dependency list (due 2027-08-04).
- Ethan: prepare materialized view PR + storage cost sim (due 2027-08-05).
- Priya: draft dashboard UX blurb and cost-telemetry lint spec; coordinate with Sasha for ops pipeline change (due 2027-08-05).
- Ravi: initial runbook fragment for "cost spike triage" and publish draft to Confluence (due 2027-08-09).

Lightweight metrics snapshot (from 2027-07-30 incident window):
- avg spans/sec (eu-west peak): 18,400 -> expected baseline 3,200
- avg span size (bytes): 2,250 -> increased from baseline 1,100
- collector CPU variance: +18% on canary cluster during preseeding
- estimated extra storage: 1.2 TB over 12 hours

Meeting notes / side-discussions:
- Priya recommended a short-lived "cost mode" for heavy dashboards that swaps to low-resolution histograms instead of full trace joins; team liked the concept as an experiment.
- Jonah suggested we tag spans with "ingestion-path" to aid downstream aggregation; Maya warned about tag cardinality — only add if suffix-mapper reduces labels first.

Next sync:
- Friday 2027-08-06 09:30 PT (30m) - focus on canary observations and materialized view cost estimate.
- Separate ad-hoc: runbook review Tues 2027-08-03 11:00 PT (1h) with on-call rotation.

Notes to self (informal):
- When updating the mapper, run the "job-dep-scan" script against prod metadata dump to avoid surprises.
- Preserve raw logs for 14 days for postmortem if spike reoccurs.

Attachments / references:
- OBS-412 (trace sampling)
summary: Tactical standup capturing sampling experiment state, dashboard cost fixes, and a cost-telemetry ingestion spike root cause with concrete action items and owners.
